# Intern Lumina U2

Intern Lumina U2 is a 16B-parameter mixture-of-experts diffusion language model from Shanghai AI Lab, released on 16 October 2026. It represents images, video and 3D as multi-codebook discrete visual tokens over a shared backbone with text, covering text-to-image generation, image editing, image and video understanding and 3D understanding. It reports a GenEval score of 89.3 and a 4.45x speedup for 1024x1024 image generation from a stability-aware sampling strategy. Weights are published on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, with checkpoints trained on Huawei Ascend NPUs and on NVIDIA GPUs.

## About This Model

Intern Lumina U2 is an open-source, 16B-parameter unified multimodal model developed by Shanghai AI Lab. Built as a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) diffusion language model, it routes inputs through sparse pathways that activate only 1.4B parameters per forward pass. Unlike typical multi-system pipelines that bolt separate vision encoders, autoregressive language backbones, and continuous latent diffusion decoders together, Intern Lumina U2 unifies text QA, text-to-image generation, image editing, video processing, and 3D spatial understanding into a single, cohesive neural architecture. [...] For developers seeking a cutting-edge local AI model 16B parameters 2026 class release, Intern Lumina U2 occupies a distinct position. It competes against both discrete unified vision-language networks such as LLaDA-o and multi-component frameworks like InternVL-U. It matches or exceeds dedicated specialized models across key metrics, achieving an 89.3 GenEval score for generative prompt alignment alongside a 4.45x inference speedup for native 1024x1024 image synthesis.

## Overview

Intern Lumina U2 is a unified multimodal model that brings language, image, video and 3D into a
single framework, covering text QA, text-to-image generation, image understanding, image editing,
video understanding and 3D understanding with one model. It is a 16B-parameter MoE with 1B active
parameters (16B-A1B), pairing an efficient sparse backbone with an 8-codebook fully-discrete visual
representation built on AToken.

## Executive Summary

The research introduces Intern Lumina U2, a novel model designed for unified multimodal generation, which combines text, images, and videos into a single framework. This model aims to address the limitations of existing approaches that either focus on discrete visual tokenizers or hybrid methods that can complicate the optimization process due to differences in how text and images are represented. [...] Intern Lumina U2 represents a significant advancement in this area by being the first diffusion language model to utilize multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. This means that each visual element is represented by multiple codes drawn from different codebooks, enhancing its representational ability while still integrating seamlessly with text modeling techniques. The model processes visual and textual data simultaneously, which could lead to more efficient data handling and improved output quality. [...] Welcome.AI
